title: Corrupt settings/layout, missing game and unsupported game version
steps: Confirm the app remains usable with corrupt settings/layout and unavailable active game.
Verify recovery-valid is restored while recovery-broken and recovery-missing are removed from the open session.
Check the fallback route and recoverable warning; use reset() to repeat startup.
Use ?journey=recovery&variant=settings (or layout, missing-game, unsupported-game)&reset=1 to isolate a fault.
Use restore-game-on/off, restore-settings-on/off or restore-library-on/off to inspect ordered session restore and analysis policy.
Use unavailable-player, unavailable-analysis, paused or board-edit to inspect restored runtime eligibility.
